metadata.title: आदिवासी भाषा पर संघर्ष | Battle over Tribal Language | Tripura | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: Kokborok is the language of indigenous communities in Tripura. There is a demand from the tribal communities to adopt roman script for the language. But the government is insisting on Bengali script for the language. In the last week of January, the President of the education board told officials to not allow students to use roman script for the examination. This has created unrest in tribal areas of the state.
